cc:Work.dc:title: How uncertainty updates as observations arrive
cc:Work.dc:description: SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL • Forecast target: realized day-180 economic contribution per acquired lead Intervals are posterior predictive, conditional on the fitted model and finite sending policy. More data can shift or widen them. Truth is shown for evaluation only; it was unavailable to the forecasting fit.
